test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series and complete the pattern

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1564f35272f589fe4adf2abfbacb5166c132b64964cd9bb8e02ab472ea0181ca.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) For the first box series →

The first two elements of 1st and 3rd column interchange positions with the same column.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1764f5402e9478025273702b1d8a05f7d0c3116a45bd44d4d449d358034935a9.png] 

2) For the second box series →

The top elements shift in the anticlockwise direction.

The center element is replaced by new element.

The rest of elements shift clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad54727bde7c729fa6e08ee9884b8db8583960254ead94778383b694172bcf72.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d76ea09a245573f7208dbd3f944e5a35c5c4645c957300bf91081c6272f61d8.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
